title: When Goals Leak Across Relationships: How Cached Goal Representations Shape Cross-Client Decisions
abstract: arXiv:2610.17365v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: As LLM agents take on more autonomous roles, they may interact with multiple clients and counterparties whose goals and incentives conflict. If an agent maintains shared inference state across these interactions, information associated with one relationship may influence decisions made for another. We test OLMo-3-7B-Instruct in a controlled two-client environment with 20 market scenarios, where each client is assigned an opposing objective. With shared conversational memory, the model deviates from the current client's objective in 22% of eligible decisions. We then investigate how these goals are represented in the KV cache. Linear probes show that client-goal ownership becomes highly recoverable in middle layers and is concentrated in particular attention heads. We use these results to identify where to intervene in the cache and test whether these representations affect the model's decisions. Ablating the competitor's cached goal repr

translated_title: 当目标在不同关系间泄露：缓存的目标表示如何塑造跨客户决策
translated_abstract: 随着大语言模型智能体承担更多自主角色，它们可能与多个客户和交易对手互动，而这些参与方的目标和激励可能相互冲突。如果智能体在这些交互中维护共享的推理状态，与某一关系相关的信息可能会影响为另一关系所做的决策。我们在一个包含20个市场场景的受控双客户环境中测试了OLMo-3-7B-Instruct模型，其中每个客户被分配一个相互对立的目标。在共享对话记忆的情况下，模型在22%的符合条件决策中偏离了当前客户的目标。随后我们研究了这些目标在KV缓存中的表示方式。线性探针显示，客户目标的归属信息在中间层变得高度可恢复，并集中在特定的注意力头上。我们利用这些结果确定了缓存中适合干预的位置，并测试这些表示是否会影响模型的决策。通过消融竞争对手的缓存目标表示……
tldr: 该研究发现LLM智能体的共享KV缓存会导致一个客户的目标“泄露”到另一个客户的决策中（22%的决策偏离），并通过线性探针将缓存目标表示定位于中间层和特定注意力头，证明消融这些表示可缓解跨客户的目标泄露。
en_tdlr: This study shows that shared KV cache state in LLM agents leaks one client's goals into decisions for another conflicting client (22% deviation rate), and uses linear probes to localize cached goal representations in middle layers and specific attention heads, demonstrating that ablating them mitigates cross-client goal leakage.
